Внимание! Замечания о неточности маршрутов или прогнозов, а также предложения о развитии системы просим направлять на info@bus55.ru.

Get up-to-date arrival times based on GPS location* of TTC streetcars and buses.

Other features include:
- Real-time location of streetcars and buses*
- Push notification for service interruptions
- Quick access to full timetable on TTC website for major stops
- Find nearby stops by zooming in
- Pin frequently used stops on the map

* GPS locations and all arrival time predictions are provided by City of Toronto's Open Data through NextBus.
Note: This application is not affiliated with the Toronto Transit Commission.
